# shopify_standard_metaobject_definition (List Resource)

Lists the standard metaobject definitions enabled on the store. Templates that aren't enabled can't be listed.

## Example Usage

```terraform
list "shopify_standard_metaobject_definition" "all" {
  provider = shopify
}
```
